text_block_list.text:
With curfew fast approaching, I spotted 
Air Shakur and the others talking in front 
of the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Running into you at this hour, what a 
coincidence. Shakur, were you having 
another staring contest with your computer 
somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Pretty much. What the heck is Her Royal 
Highness up to, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Actually, I got hungry, so I had 
some cup ramen delivered.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ramen is great for lunch, but don't you 
think it tastes even better in the middle 
of the night?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"In the middle of the night, you've 
already moved your body and used your 
head. Your energy's purely tapped out, so 
you're starving, and food just tastes way 
better than during the day."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Then Shakur, do you want to 
come grab some ramen with us right now?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If you were focusing on the PC, that means 
you were using your brain, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Don't need it. Supplements cover whatever 
I'm lacking. Eating at this hour just 
turns into fat anyway."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~... Food is super important, you know? 
I don't think you should hold back when 
you're hungry, but what do you think, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Watching your calories is important too, 
let's just make do with supplements.

Holding back isn't good for you—eat a 
proper meal.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... meals are supposed to be 
delicious and enjoyable too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Still, as expected of trainees under the 
same Trainer. The two of you are totally 
in sync.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah? I don't get what you're trying to 
say.

And so, Air Shakur efficiently took in her 
nutrients today as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't go running your mouth like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
See, Trainer gave us permission, so let's 
eat cup noodles together♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Look at you, casually preparing two cups 
of instant noodles. You planned on 
dragging me into this from the start, 
didn't you?

In the end, Air Shakur was dragged along 
for late-night ramen.
